# For each year, render last 20 pages and OCR first ~3 lines (headers) + bottom page num
find_cp_range() {
  local year="$1"
  local pdf="$2"
  local pages
  pages=$(pdfinfo "$pdf" | awk '/Pages:/ {print $2}')
  local start=$((pages - 19))
  if [ "$start" -lt 1 ]; then start=1; fi
  local outdir="$WORKDIR/$year"
  mkdir -p "$outdir"
  rm -f "$outdir"/*.png "$outdir"/*.txt
  gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -dQUIET -sDEVICE=pnggray -r120 \
    -dFirstPage=$start -dLastPage=$pages \
    -sOutputFile="$outdir/p%d.png" "$pdf"
  
  echo "YEAR $year total=$pages scan=$start-$pages"
  local i=1
  local pdfpage=$start
  while [ -f "$outdir/p$i.png" ]; do
    # OCR top portion only for speed - crop top 15%
    convert "$outdir/p$i.png" -gravity North -crop 100%x18%+0+0 "$outdir/top$i.png" 2>/dev/null
    header=$(tesseract "$outdir/top$i.png" stdout -l eng --psm 6 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/  */ /g')
    # also get bottom page number
    convert "$outdir/p$i.png" -gravity South -crop 100%x8%+0+0 "$outdir/bot$i.png" 2>/dev/null
    footer=$(tesseract "$outdir/bot$i.png" stdout -l eng --psm 7 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/  */ /g')
    printf "  PDF%3d | %s | footer:%s\n" "$pdfpage" "$header" "$footer"
    i=$((i+1))
    pdfpage=$((pdfpage+1))
  done
}

for y in 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 2017 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2024; do
  find_cp_range "$y" "$BASE/$y/$y.pdf"
  echo
done

BASE="/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Materials/Phy/dse/Year2/candidate performance"
WORKDIR="/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Materials/Phy/dse/Year2/_ocr_md_work"
RAW="$WORKDIR/raw"
mkdir -p "$RAW"
OCR_BIN=/tmp/vision_ocr

ocr_year() {
  local year="$1"
  local pdf="$BASE/${year} performance.pdf"
  local pages
  pages=$(pdfinfo "$pdf" | awk '/Pages:/ {print $2}')
  local ydir="$RAW/$year"
  mkdir -p "$ydir"
  echo "[$year] rendering $pages pages..."
  gs -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -dQUIET -sDEVICE=png16m -r300 \
    -sOutputFile="$ydir/page_%03d.png" "$pdf"
  local i=1
  while [ $i -le $pages ]; do
    local img
    img=$(printf "%s/page_%03d.png" "$ydir" "$i")
    local out
    out=$(printf "%s/page_%03d.txt" "$ydir" "$i")
    local meta
    meta=$(printf "%s/page_%03d.meta" "$ydir" "$i")
    # 2024 uses 2-up scans - allow auto column detection; others force single
    if [ "$year" = "2024" ]; then
      "$OCR_BIN" "$img" > "$out" 2>"$meta"
    else
      "$OCR_BIN" --single "$img" > "$out" 2>"$meta"
    fi
    # Also tesseract backup for option-letter recovery
    tesseract "$img" stdout -l eng --psm 6 2>/dev/null > "${out%.txt}.tess.txt"
    echo "  page $i/$pages $(cat "$meta" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n')"
    i=$((i+1))
  done
}

for y in 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 2017 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025; do

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build annotation-ready Markdown from Vision + Tesseract OCR of Candidates' Performance PDFs."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

RAW = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Materials/Phy/dse/Year2/_ocr_md_work/raw")
OUT = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Materials/Phy/dse/Year2/candidate performance")

WATERMARK_NOISE = re.compile(
    r"\b(PUBLIC|LIBRARIES|HONG\s*KONG\s*PUBLIC\s*LIBRARIES|香港公共圖書館)\b",
    re.I,
)
PAGE_NUM_ONLY = re.compile(r"^\d{1,3}$")
OPT_LINE = re.compile(
    r"^(?P<star>\*?)\s*(?P<letter>[A-D])\s*[\.\:\)]\s*(?P<body>.*?)(?:\s*\((?P<pct>\d{1,3})\s*%\s*\))?\s*$"
)
Q_START = re.compile(r"^(?P<num>\d{1,2})\s*[\.\)]\s*(?P<body>.*)$")
PCT_ONLY = re.compile(r"^\((\d{1,3})\s*%\)$")


def clean_line(s: str) -> str:
    s = s.replace("\u00a0", " ")
    s = WATERMARK_NOISE.sub("", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", s).strip()
    # Common OCR fixes for these reports
    s = s.replace("Paper I ", "Paper 1 ")
    s = s.replace("Paper | ", "Paper 1 ")
    s = s.replace("Paper |", "Paper 1")
    s = s.replace("Al questions", "All questions")
    s = s.replace("Alll ", "All ")
    s = s.replace("School-hased", "School-based")
    s = s.replace("Astranamy", "Astronomy")
    s = s.replace("Physies", "Physics")
    return s


def parse_meta(meta_path: Path) -> dict:
    text = meta_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    conf = re.search(r"avg_conf=([0-9.]+)", text)
    boxes = re.search(r"boxes=(\d+)", text)
    cols = "yes" in text and "columns=yes" in text
    return {
        "avg_conf": float(conf.group(1)) if conf else None,
        "boxes": int(boxes.group(1)) if boxes else None,
        "columns": cols,
    }


def extract_tess_options(tess_text: str) -> dict[int, list[str]]:
    """Map approximate question context -> option lines from tesseract (A-D with %)."""
    options: list[str] = []
    for line in tess_text.splitlines():
        line = clean_line(line)
        m = OPT_LINE.match(line)
        if m:
            star = "*" if m.group("star") or line.lstrip().startswith("*") else ""
            body = m.group("body").strip()
            pct = m.group("pct")
            pct_s = f" ({pct}%)" if pct else ""
            options.append(f"- {star}{m.group('letter')}. {body}{pct_s}".rstrip())
    return options


def merge_option_letters(vision_lines: list[str], tess_text: str) -> list[str]:
    """If Vision drops A/B/C labels but Tess has them, prefer Tess option block lines nearby."""
    tess_opts = []
    for line in tess_text.splitlines():
        cl = clean_line(line)
        # Normalize tess option lines
        cl = re.sub(r"^\*\s*", "*", cl)
        cl = re.sub(r"^wil\s+Os\s+", "*C. ", cl)  # common tess misread of *C.
        cl = re.sub(r"^Cc\.", "C.", cl)
        m = OPT_LINE.match(cl)
        if m:
            star = "*" if (m.group("star") or cl.startswith("*")) else ""
            body = m.group("body").strip()
            pct = m.group("pct")
            pct_s = f" ({pct}%)" if pct else ""
            tess_opts.append((m.group("letter"), f"{star}{m.group('letter')}. {body}{pct_s}".strip()))

    if not tess_opts:
        return vision_lines

    # Count how many vision lines look like options missing letters
    vision_pct_lines = [
        i
        for i, ln in enumerate(vision_lines)
        if re.search(r"\(\d{1,3}\s*%\)", ln) and not OPT_LINE.match(ln) and not ln.startswith("- ")
    ]
    # If Vision already has good option labels, keep Vision
    vision_labeled = sum(1 for ln in vision_lines if OPT_LINE.match(ln) or re.match(r"^-?\s*\*?[A-D]\.", ln))
    if vision_labeled >= 3 and len(vision_pct_lines) < 2:
        return vision_lines

    # Build a lookup of percentage -> tess option for patching
    by_pct: dict[str, str] = {}
    for letter, full in tess_opts:
        pm = re.search(r"\((\d{1,3})\s*%\)", full)
        if pm:
            by_pct[pm.group(1)] = full

    out = []
    for ln in vision_lines:
        if OPT_LINE.match(ln) or re.match(r"^-?\s*\*?[A-D]\.", ln):
            out.append(ln if ln.startswith("- ") else f"- {ln}")
            continue
        pm = re.search(r"\((\d{1,3})\s*%\)\s*$", ln)
        if pm and pm.group(1) in by_pct:
            out.append(f"- {by_pct[pm.group(1)]}")
        else:
            out.append(ln)
    return out


def structure_page(text: str, tess_text: str, page_idx: int, meta: dict) -> str:
    lines = [clean_line(l) for l in text.splitlines()]
    lines = [l for l in lines if l and not PAGE_NUM_ONLY.match(l)]
    # Drop COLUMN_BREAK markers into horizontal rules for dual pages
    lines = ["---" if l == "---COLUMN_BREAK---" else l for l in lines]
    lines = merge_option_letters(lines, tess_text)

    blocks: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        ln = lines[i]
        if ln in {"Candidates' Performance", "Candidates’ Performance"}:
            blocks.append("# Candidates' Performance")
            i += 1
            continue
        if re.match(r"^Paper\s*[12]\b", ln, re.I) and len(ln) < 20:
            blocks.append(f"## {ln.replace('Paper 1', 'Paper 1').replace('Paper I', 'Paper 1')}")
            i += 1
            continue
        if ln.startswith("Section A") or ln.startswith("Section B") or ln.startswith("Section C") or ln.startswith("Section D"):
            blocks.append(f"### {ln}")
            i += 1
            continue
        if ln.startswith("School-based Assessment"):
            blocks.append(f"## {ln}")
            i += 1
            continue
        if ln == "---":
            blocks.append("\n---\n")
            i += 1
            continue

        qm = Q_START.match(ln)
        if qm and int(qm.group("num")) <= 40:
            # Start a question block; accumulate until next question or section
            qnum = qm.group("num")
            body = qm.group("body").strip()
            chunk = [f"#### Question {qnum}", ""]
            if body:
                chunk.append(body)
            i += 1
            while i < len(lines):
                nxt = lines[i]
                if nxt.startswith("### ") or nxt.startswith("## ") or nxt == "---":
                    break
                if Q_START.match(nxt) and int(Q_START.match(nxt).group("num")) <= 40:
                    # Heuristic: new question if line starts with N. and previous ended options/commentary
                    break
                if nxt.startswith("Section ") or nxt.startswith("Paper "):
                    break
                # Format option lines
                om = OPT_LINE.match(nxt)
                if om:
                    star = "*" if om.group("star") else ""
                    body_o = om.group("body").strip()
                    pct = om.group("pct")
                    pct_s = f" ({pct}%)" if pct else ""
                    chunk.append(f"- {star}{om.group('letter')}. {body_o}{pct_s}".rstrip())
                elif nxt.startswith("- "):
                    chunk.append(nxt)
                else:
                    chunk.append(nxt)
                i += 1
            blocks.append("\n".join(chunk))
            continue

        # Option line outside explicit Q block
        om = OPT_LINE.match(ln)
        if om:
            star = "*" if om.group("star") else ""
            body_o = om.group("body").strip()
            pct = om.group("pct")
            pct_s = f" ({pct}%)" if pct else ""
            blocks.append(f"- {star}{om.group('letter')}. {body_o}{pct_s}".rstrip())
            i += 1
            continue

        blocks.append(ln)
        i += 1

    conf = meta.get("avg_conf")
    conf_s = f"{conf:.3f}" if conf is not None else "n/a"
    header = f"<!-- page {page_idx} | vision_avg_conf={conf_s} -->\n"
    body = "\n".join(blocks)
    # Collapse excessive blank lines
    body = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", body).strip()
    return header + body + "\n"


def build_year(year: str) -> Path:
    ydir = RAW / year
    pages = sorted(ydir.glob("page_*.txt"))
    # exclude .tess.txt
    pages = [p for p in pages if not p.name.endswith(".tess.txt")]
    confs = []
    parts = [
        "---",
        f"year: {year}",
        "subject: Physics",
        "exam: HKDSE",
        "section: Candidates' Performance",
        "source_pdf: " + f'"{year} performance.pdf"',
        "ocr:",
        "  primary: Apple Vision (accurate)",
        "  secondary: Tesseract (option-letter merge)",
        "  render_dpi: 300",
        "purpose: Transcript for annotating question statements in database",
        "notes: Diagrams are omitted or partially captured; asterisk (*) marks the keyed correct option when present.",
        "---",
        "",
        f"# HKDSE Physics {year} - Candidates' Performance",
        "",
    ]

    for p in pages:
        idx = int(re.search(r"(\d+)", p.stem).group(1))
        meta = parse_meta(p.with_suffix(".meta"))
        if meta.get("avg_conf") is not None:
            confs.append(meta["avg_conf"])
        tess_path = p.with_suffix("").with_suffix(".tess.txt")  # page_001.tess.txt
        # fix: page_001.txt -> page_001.tess.txt
        tess_path = Path(str(p).replace(".txt", ".tess.txt"))
        tess_text = tess_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if tess_path.exists() else ""
        vision_text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        parts.append(structure_page(vision_text, tess_text, idx, meta))
        parts.append("")

    if confs:
        parts.insert(-1, f"\n<!-- overall_avg_conf={sum(confs)/len(confs):.3f} pages={len(confs)} -->\n")

    out = OUT / f"{year} performance.md"
    out.write_text("\n".join(parts).rstrip() + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return out


def main():
    years = [
        "2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016", "2017", "2018",
        "2019", "2020", "2021", "2022", "2023", "2024", "2025",
    ]
    for y in years:
        path = build_year(y)
        print(f"wrote {path} ({path.stat().st_size} bytes)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
